'''Darth Rivan's personal journals''' were a pair of [[Book/Legends|books]] that contained the writings of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Rivan]]. The journals came to be located within the bowels of [[Almas Sith fortress|Rivan's fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Almas]] and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the books were recovered from the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] by a team of [[Jedi Researcher|Jedi researchers]]. The researchers turned the tomes over to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], the governing body of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and a section of the journals that detailed Rivan's thoughts on the [[Darkstaff]], a powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], was published on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].
